seoDescription: The story, goals, and vision behind Studiwelt.

hero.name: Diyorbek
hero.intro: Germany is one of the world's hidden gems for higher education, and one of the most confusing places to actually get into. I'm building Studiwelt so that no one has to find their way through that maze alone.

photoAlt: Portrait of Diyorbek, author of Studiwelt

motivation.title: Why I built Studiwelt
motivation.body: Germany is a hidden gem for higher education: world-class, and often almost free. But the way in is a black box: applications, bureaucracy, Studienkollegs, entrance exams, and deadlines that no one ever explains clearly. I went through every step of it myself, so I understand anyone who decides to study for next to nothing in this wonderful country. That is why Studiwelt is not only about Studienkollegs; it is for everyone who wants to come to Germany to study, to work, or to start something new. Studienkollegs are our focus today; if the idea finds its people, we will grow far beyond them.

goal.title: The goal
goal.body: To build more than a platform: a whole community. A place where people standing before the same leap learn together, share what they have figured out, and carry one another all the way to the finish line.

vision.title: The vision
vision.body: Education should be within reach for everyone. Studiwelt exists so that reaching your goals costs you neither your nerves nor your savings. Our bootcamp is priced a world apart from the usual paid courses and admission programs, just enough to keep the platform alive and the servers running, and never a barrier to getting started.

cta.title: Ready to start your journey?
cta.description: Join the students preparing for their Studienkolleg entrance exam with a structured, daily plan.
